{{Otheruses|General Orders}}
The '''general orders''' were the set of bylaws around which [[The Crucible]] slave ring was built. They included a provision which declared that any interaction with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was to be handled by the [[Magister Protector]].
